transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I came in because... well, things at work have been really rough lately. They changed my hours at the warehouse and brought in this whole new inventory system, and ever since then, I just feel like I'm falling apart. It's getting bad. I'm missing my shifts, I'm skipping out on my church commitments, and I've been snapping at my family a lot. Some mornings, I just sit there on the edge of the bed in my work boots, just staring, wondering if I can even face going into that place anymore. It's just too much.
Most days, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless for most of the day?

No, I wouldn't really say I feel depressed or hopeless. I'm not walking around sad all day or crying or anything like that. It's... well, I just feel incredibly stressed and overwhelmed by what's going on at the warehouse. When I'm not thinking about the job, I feel alright, I guess. It's really just the pressure of all those changes that's getting to me, not so much a depressed feeling.
Besides work, do you find yourself constantly worrying about other everyday areas of your life, like your family, health, or finances?
No, not really. I mean, my family is fine, health is okay for my age, and the bills are getting paid. It's really just the job. That's the only thing that's got me tied up in knots right now.
